reviews.text: im ezcited to use it.just my first purchased.im just reading a lot of feedback with this and im curious to use it.Im using the other one the regular one and ive love it so much jjust try to use this one if what is gonna do with this to my skin
reviews.zh: 我好期待用。第一次買。我睇咗好多關於佢嘅評價，好想試吓。我用緊另一款 regular 嗰隻，超鍾意，所以想試吓呢款睇吓會對我塊皮膚有咩效果

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB BIRCH JUICE MOISTURIZING TONE-UP SUNSCREEN 50ml Special Set (+Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: It's alright. I love their normal birch sunscreen and it's my go to: no grease or white cast. However this product really does kind of pill and really just sits on top of the skin without blending in right. If you have any dry patches or skin texture I wouldn't recommend. It does have that slight color correcting effect, but with how it sits I can't apply enough to completely cover up the spots I want. Not the worst tone up product I've tried but not the best either. If you have really clear, smooth skin though this could be nice with the added sun protection
reviews.zh: 一般般。我好鍾意佢哋正常嗰隻 birch 防曬，係我嘅 daily go to：唔油笠又唔泛白。但呢款產品真係會起粒粒，真係成層坐喺皮膚表面推唔開。如果你有任何乾燥甩皮或者皮膚紋理，我唔推薦。佢係有少少校色效果，但因為佢成層坐喺度，我冇辦法搽到足夠份量去完全覆蓋我想遮嘅斑。唔算我用過最差嘅 tone up 產品，但都唔算最好。如果你皮膚真係好清好滑，配合防曬效果可能會幾啱用

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB BIRCH JUICE MOISTURIZING TONE-UP SUNSCREEN 50ml Special Set (+Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: The product blends nicely into the skin and gives a bit of coverage. It feels slightly sticky on the skin and has a matte finish, I personally prefer a gloy look so It’s not for me but if you like a matte finish, it’s a good produc
reviews.zh: 產品容易融入皮膚，有少許遮瑕度。搽上皮膚有少少黏笠感，妝效係霧面，我自己就比較鍾意光澤感所以唔啱我，但如果鍾意霧面妝效嘅話，係一支唔錯嘅產品

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB BIRCH JUICE MOISTURIZING TONE-UP SUNSCREEN 50ml Special Set (+Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text:
This is my 4th repurchasing for this sunscreen! 
The skin be glowing and dewy af after this. So easy for the days I dont wanna wear makeup, just this and some blush on fire and also the tex is so easy to blend unlike other physical sunscreens!
reviews.zh:
已經係第4次回購呢支防曬！
用完之後皮膚會發光又超水潤。唔想化妝嘅日子就好方便，搽佢再加胭脂就搞掂，而且質地超易推開，唔似其他物理性防曬咁難用！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB BIRCH JUICE MOISTURIZING TONE-UP SUNSCREEN 50ml Special Set (+Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: En la primera foto puedes ver un lado de la cara con el protector solar y del otro lado sin producto, casi ni se nota el color, en mi caso es muy leve, cuando no me quiero maquillar solo coloco el protector y unifica el tono y la textura natural de la piel, no es grasoso aunque la textura del producto es ligera no te deja la piel grasosa si no más bien hidratada. Es mi protector favorito hasta ahora!
reviews.zh: 第一張相你可以見到塊面一邊有搽防曬，另一邊就冇，幾乎睇唔出有顏色，我嘅情況係非常淡，唔想化妝嘅時候我就淨係搽防曬，就可以均勻膚色同保留皮膚原有嘅質感，質地輕盈但唔會令皮膚油笠笠，反而係水潤。係我暫時最鍾意嘅防曬！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB BIRCH JUICE MOISTURIZING TONE-UP SUNSCREEN 50ml Special Set (+Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: It has very light pink colour and leaves very little white cast. White cast kind of brightens and evens out the skin tone. White cast is not noticeable. It's not sticky on the skin and also doesn't have typical sunscreen scent.
reviews.zh: 帶好淺嘅粉紅色，泛白情況好輕微。泛白反而有種提亮同均勻膚色嘅效果。泛白唔明顯。搽喺皮膚上唔黏笠，亦都冇一般防曬嘅味道。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB BIRCH JUICE MOISTURIZING TONE-UP SUNSCREEN 50ml Special Set (+Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: Honestly I thought this was the sunscreen by itself, and not a moisturizer. I still have been using it regardless because I felt bad. I’m not mad about the product. It makes my skin look glowy and lighter. It’s nice and can usually stay on till the end of the day.
reviews.zh: 講真我以為呢個淨係防曬，唔係保濕霜。但我仲係繼續用，因為用咗掉咗覺得嘥。產品本身我冇唔滿意。令到我塊面有光澤又白啲。幾好用，通常可以用到收工。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB BIRCH JUICE MOISTURIZING TONE-UP SUNSCREEN 50ml Special Set (+Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: i got this one because the original was out of stock but this one is amazing still. if your on the tan side i wouldn’t really get this since it can be a little hard to blend in but it takes some time to get rid of it
reviews.zh: 原本嗰隻冇貨所以揀咗呢隻，但呢隻一樣好正。如果你膚色偏深嘅話我就唔太推薦呢隻，因為比較難推開，要花啲時間先搞掂
